evidence.title: GitHub - abi/screenshot-to-code: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue) · GitHub

name: Screenshot to Code
summary: Web app that converts a screenshot or design into clean code, with HTML, Tailwind, React and Vue output per its repo.
description: Drop a screenshot or design in and get code back. The project's GitHub repository lists HTML, Tailwind, React and Vue as output targets. The hosted site is JavaScript-rendered, so only its title and meta description were readable and details like pricing and accounts are unverified.
contains: converts a screenshot or design into code
output targets listed: HTML, Tailwind, React, Vue
